summary.text: Noah Burroughs is a Democratic member of the New York State Assembly representing District 18, which he has represented since January 1, 2025, and is seeking re-election on the Democratic and Working Families Party lines in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Burroughs received his high school diploma from Hempstead High School, and his career experience includes working as an educator.
